parameters.query: SELECT te.id AS enrollment_id, te.enrollment_id AS teller_enrollment_id, te.institution_name, te.status, pgp_sym_decrypt(te.access_token_enc, '{{ $env.TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE }}') AS access_token, te.last_synced_txn_date, json_agg(la.account_id) AS account_ids FROM teller_enrollments te JOIN linked_accounts la ON la.teller_enrollment_id = te.id WHERE te.status != 'SUSPENDED' GROUP BY te.id ORDER BY te.id

INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, transaction_id, amount, iso_currency_code, date, merchant_name, name, category, pending)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.account_id }}',
  '{{ $json.transaction_id }}',
  {{ $json.amount }},
  '{{ $json.iso_currency_code }}',
  '{{ $json.date }}',
  {{ $json.merchant_name ? "'" + $json.merchant_name.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.category ? "ARRAY['" + $json.category.replace(/'/g, "''") + "']" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.pending }}
)
ON CONFLICT (transaction_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  amount = EXCLUDED.amount,
  date = EXCLUDED.date,
  merchant_name = EXCLUDED.merchant_name,
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  category = EXCLUDED.category,
  pending = EXCLUDED.pending;
UPDATE teller_enrollments SET last_synced_txn_date = '{{ $json.sync_date }}', updated_at = now() WHERE id = {{ $json.enrollment_id }};
UPDATE teller_enrollments SET status = '{{ $json.error_state }}' WHERE id = {{ $json.enrollment_id }};
